data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'harmos' meaning 'joint' or 'harmony'. In Christian tradition, Harmaning represents the perfect unity and balance between man and nature, as well as the harmonious union between the soul and God. The name Harmaning carries the meaning “Harmony of man and nature” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Harmaning usually hope their child will grow to embody harmony of man and nature and live with faith, good character and purpose.
